meta.title: REX — Review documents with AI, without surrendering the file
meta.audience: Engineers and tech leads deciding whether REX should replace copy-pasting passages from technical documents into a separate AI chat.

sections.title: REX

sections.title: One review, many document formats
sections.voiceover: Copying passages into chat separates questions from their source. REX brings Markdown, HTML, Word, PDF, and PowerPoint into one workspace, keeping the review with the document.

sections.title: Inspect the change, then approve it
sections.voiceover: ASK cannot write. ACT moves the same conversation onto an isolated working copy, then puts every proposed line behind a review bar. Original, Both, and New expose the edit from each side. Only Approve writes the file. REX then checks every comment again: unchanged passages stay attached, and removed text is flagged for review.

actions.text: Three items stand between the current state and a safe cutover. The statement endpoint has regressed and now misses its latency objective by roughly 50%. The rollback path has been designed but never rehearsed against the 30-minute recovery objective. And only one of the two required game days has been run, which leaves half the on-call rotation working from a runbook they have not exercised.

sections.title: Follow the record down to one message
sections.voiceover: Traffic keeps the record of every chat. For requests through the built-in gateway, drill down to the messages sent and received. Tokens, timing, failures, and the provider route stay attached. The exact request and response JSON are readable and copyable.

actions.note: Choose the seeded ASK turn explicitly; ACT creates another Open turn button.
Resume on the actual path-free system prompt after edited navigation.
Select the system message's content string, not its root object, so the right pane shows readable text with real line breaks.

actions.text: (async () => { const root = document.querySelector('#rex-root').shadowRoot; for (let i=0;i<80;i++) { if (root.querySelector('[aria-label="One message"] h1')?.textContent === 'Response') return; const next = root.querySelector('button[aria-label="The message after this one"]'); if (!next || next.disabled) throw new Error('Response not available in the actual exchange'); next.click(); await new Promise(done=>setTimeout(done,100)); } throw new Error('Response pager exceeded its limit'); })()
actions.note: Edited cut: traverse real path-bearing request rows off camera, without rewriting the record.

sections.title: Review where the work lives
